title: Healthcare & Clinics
summary: Appointment, patient record and communication software for clinics and care providers.
challenges: Manual appointment booking and no-shows
Patient records scattered across paper and spreadsheets
Slow communication between front desk and doctors
solutions: Secure patient and visit records with role-based access
imageAlt: Two clinicians reviewing patient information together on a tablet

title: Retail & E-commerce
summary: Online stores, POS and inventory systems that keep stock and sales in sync.
challenges: Stock mismatch between shop and online store
Low conversion on slow storefronts
Manual order and invoice handling
solutions: Billing and POS integrated with the store
Sales dashboards by product and branch
imageAlt: Online store owner photographing a product at a desk with a laptop and shipping boxes

title: Education & EdTech
summary: Learning platforms, admissions and school management software.
challenges: Paper-based admissions and fee tracking
Parents and staff using separate disconnected tools
Limited reporting on attendance and results
imageAlt: Students working on a laptop in a classroom with a teacher

title: Real Estate
summary: Listing websites, lead management and site-visit workflows for builders and agents.
challenges: Leads lost between calls, messages and portals
Outdated project and inventory information
No clear view of site-visit to booking conversion
solutions: Project and listing websites with enquiry capture
imageAlt: Modern apartment building with balconies against a pale sky

title: Logistics & Supply Chain
summary: Tracking, dispatch and partner portals for transport and distribution businesses.
challenges: Limited visibility of shipments and fleet
Manual dispatch and proof-of-delivery paperwork
Disconnected partner and customer communication
imageAlt: Forklift moving a pallet of goods in a busy distribution warehouse

title: Hospitality & Travel
summary: Direct booking websites and operations tools for hotels, resorts and travel businesses.
challenges: High commission from third-party booking platforms
Manual enquiry handling over calls and chats
Seasonal demand that is hard to forecast
solutions: Direct booking websites with enquiry flows
imageAlt: Stylish hotel reception desk and lobby

title: Manufacturing & Industrial
summary: Production tracking, inventory and dealer portals for manufacturers and suppliers.
challenges: Production and stock tracked in spreadsheets
Slow quotation and order processing
Limited visibility for dealers and distributors
imageAlt: Operator running heavy machinery on a factory production line

title: Professional & Financial Services
summary: Client portals, document workflows and lead-generating websites for firms and consultants.
challenges: Document exchange over email and chat
Slow onboarding of new clients

title: Startups & SaaS
summary: MVP development, product engineering and scaling support for early-stage teams.
challenges: Limited budget and a tight launch window
Unclear scope and shifting priorities
